class.name: ZIPPacker
class.brief_description: Allows the creation of ZIP files.

method.name: add_directory
method.description: Adds directory to the archive. If [param modified_time] is set to [code]0[/code], current system time is used. [b]Note:[/b] Directories are automatically created when [method start_file] is called, use this function before adding files to create directories with custom permissions and modification time.

method.name: close
method.description: Closes the underlying resources used by this instance.

method.name: close_file
method.description: Stops writing to a file within the archive. It will fail if there is no open file.

method.name: open
method.description: Opens a zip file for writing at the given path using the specified write mode. This must be called before everything else.

method.name: open_file
method.description: Starts writing to a file within the archive. Only one file can be written at the same time. If [param modified_time] is set to [code]0[/code], current system time is used. Must be called after [method open]. If [param zip64] is set to [code]true[/code], the file will be written in ZIP64 format, otherwise, in ZIP32 format. The file must be written in ZIP64 format if the total number of bytes written by [method write_file] will be greater than [constant UINT32_MAX] ([code]0xFFFFFFFF[/code]). Otherwise, the file should be written in ZIP32 format for compatibility reasons.

method.name: start_file
method.deprecated: This method does not support ZIP64. Use [method open_file] instead.
method.description: Starts writing to a file within the archive. Only one file can be written at the same time. If [param modified_time] is set to [code]0[/code], current system time is used. Must be called after [method open]. The file will always be written in ZIP32 format. As such, if the file exceeds [constant UINT32_MAX] ([code]0xFFFFFFFF[/code]), then [method write_file] will fail. To write files in either ZIP32 or ZIP64 format, use [method open_file] instead.

method.name: write_file
method.description: Write the given [param data] to the file. Needs to be called after [method start_file].

members.member: The compression level used when [method start_file] is called. Use [enum ZIPPacker.CompressionLevel] as a reference.

constants.constant: Create a new zip archive at the given path.
Append a new zip archive to the end of the already existing file at the given path.
Add new files to the existing zip archive at the given path.
Start a file with the default Deflate compression level ([code]6[/code]). This is a good compromise between speed and file size.

Start a file with no compression. This is also known as the "Store" compression mode and is the fastest method of packing files inside a ZIP archive. Consider using this mode for files that are already compressed (such as JPEG, PNG, MP3, or Ogg Vorbis files).

Start a file with the fastest Deflate compression level ([code]1[/code]). This is fast to compress, but results in larger file sizes than [constant COMPRESSION_DEFAULT]. Decompression speed is generally unaffected by the chosen compression level.

Start a file with the best Deflate compression level ([code]9[/code]). This is slow to compress, but results in smaller file sizes than [constant COMPRESSION_DEFAULT]. Decompression speed is generally unaffected by the chosen compression level.
